result.title: SemPurify: Semantics-Aware Data Purification for Black-box Backdoor Defense
result.comment: Accepted by the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
result.summary: Backdoor attacks have emerged as a critical security threat in machine learning, where adversaries embed triggers within poisoned training samples to manipulate a model's predictions on targeted inputs while leaving its general behavior unaffected. This stealthy nature makes backdoor attacks difficult to detect, as the model functions normally until activated by a specific malicious trigger. Current purification-based defenses use image transformations (e.g., blurring) to disrupt trigger patterns but often degrade image quality. Even with advanced restoration techniques like diffusion models, these approaches can still alter visual or semantic information, reducing utility for downstream tasks. To address this, we propose the first semantics-aware data purification framework for black-box backdoor defense, SemPurify, which explicitly incorporates multi-level semantics (i.e., low-level semantic embeddings and high-level image tags) within a text-to-image (T2I) framework to guide image restoration during purification. Using this semantic information, the T2I model subsequently refines the transformed samples, helping preserve visual details and semantic information during restoration. Extensive experiments spanning multiple backdoor scenarios, i.e., classification models, CLIP-style encoders, and generative models, demonstrate that SemPurify reliably removes backdoors while effectively preserving semantic information for downstream tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SemPurify，一个面向黑盒后门防御的语义感知数据净化框架，利用低层语义嵌入与高层图像标签引导 T2I 模型修复被扰动的训练样本，以在去除后门的同时保留视觉与语义信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作关注的是训练数据净化与后门防御，未涉及 VLM 的 latent 推理状态生成、证据使用或停止决策，也无可供核查的表示或训练监督线索，故与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
